summary.intent: Execute Phase 36 (inline upload progress) using the GSD workflow, then simplify the resulting code and resolve all PR review comments.
summary.outcome: Phase 36 completed with 2 plans across 2 waves, a React hooks order bug was caught by the verifier and fixed inline, the code was simplified with significant performance and quality improvements, and all 13 PR review threads were resolved across two rounds.

repo: Upload store lives at apps/web/src/stores/upload.store.ts and was refactored from batch-level to per-file Map<string, PerFileUpload> tracking in this phase
FileList.tsx uses virtual entry merging to show in-flight uploads as rows alongside real files, with folder-scoped filtering
useFileUpload hook and uploadFiles function were dead code with zero consumers — safely deleted
The GSD worktree merge flow requires manually resolving STATE.md conflicts by taking the agent's version
cancelFile was made atomic (cancel + remove in single set()) to eliminate a two-step race condition
Upload IDs use crypto.randomUUID() (or equivalent) for collision safety — Date.now()-based IDs were a collision risk
uploadedCids tracking in useDropUpload had a bug: SDK-registered CIDs (fully committed) were being pushed alongside orphan CIDs, causing valid uploads to be unpinned on partial batch failure
retryFile store action was removed entirely — retry flow now calls removeFile then handleFileDrop to create a fresh entry, eliminating duplicate entry bug

code.finding: React Rules of Hooks violation: useCallback hooks were defined after an early return (if (!file) return null), causing 'Rendered more hooks than previous render' when file is removed from store during completion flash

Zustand v5 selector returning new array on every tick caused full file list re-renders on each progress update — fixed with ref-based equality check (useStoreWithEqualityFn from zustand/traditional is unavailable; ref pattern used instead)
updateFileProgress was cloning the Map and calling set() even when progress value was unchanged — added same-value guard to skip no-op updates
CSS reduced-motion media query didn't cover the upload progress pulse animation selector — specificity gap
During 'encrypting' status (indeterminate progress), aria-valuenow was still being set — correct pattern is to omit aria-valuenow and use aria-valuetext instead
onRetry is optional on the component props, but retry button was always rendered when status was 'error' — should be conditional on both onRetry being defined and file.file existing for re-upload

workflow: GSD verifier caught a real React hooks violation that automated type-checking missed — verification step adds genuine value
The simplify skill (/simplify) is effective for post-execution cleanup: launched 3 parallel review agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) then aggregated findings
GSD worktree agents commit with --no-verify; orchestrator merges via git merge and must manually resolve STATE.md conflicts taking the agent's version
Stale worktrees from previous sessions accumulate and should be pruned; git worktree remove --force handles worktrees with uncommitted changes
PR review comment resolution workflow: fetch via GraphQL reviewThreads, reply via REST with --field in_reply_to (integer), resolve via GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation
Two rounds of PR review comments were needed — first round triggered a second automated review with new findings
Fixing cancelFile to be atomic (delete instead of status change) required updating all status === 'cancelled' guards in useDropUpload to check for undefined (missing entry) instead

friction: Worktree merge required manual STATE.md conflict resolution each time — repetitive step in the GSD orchestration flow
Zustand v5 doesn't cleanly support custom equality functions on bound store hooks without useStoreWithEqualityFn from zustand/traditional — required a ref-based workaround
The stale worktree (cipher-box-wt-phase36) from a previous session was still present and needed manual removal

Making cancelFile atomic (delete instead of status update) had a subtle downstream effect: the 'cancelled' status guard in useDropUpload's upload loop no longer worked because the entry was gone — required changing the guard from status check to undefined check
Background commit task notification arrived after the phase was already marked complete, creating minor confusion
open_items: ci-debug worktree created at /Users/michael/Code/cipher-box-ci-debug on branch ci-debug — CI debugging work was deferred and the worktree remains
Silent drop failures (PR thread #3) were marked 'not applicable' as pre-existing behavior — the underlying issue of silently swallowing file drop errors is unaddressed
SDK upload path lacks cancel token support (PR thread #4) — marked not applicable as a pre-existing SDK limitation, but cancellation during SDK uploads is a real gap
useFileUpload hook deletion removes a public API surface that external consumers could theoretically use — verify no downstream packages import it

HUMAN-UAT.md workflow: if verifier returns human_needed, a UAT file is created with status: partial and surfaces in future progress checks — Phase 36 verification passed so no UAT file was created, but the pattern should be understood for future phases
